purpose_context: Concurrent spec-kitty next invocations on one run are not serialised (#5854), and two overlapping next --result success calls complete whatever step is issued at the second read (#5682). This mission closes both by recording the caller-evaluated step and refusing a stale advance, and by holding a per-run-dir lock across the read-modify-write of the run cursor.
purpose_tldr: Make advancing a mission run serialised: a stale advance is refused with a named reason, never silently re-planned as success; at most one next mutates a run at a time.
